title: A No-Go Theorem for the Mass-Radius Relation of Solitons
summary: We prove a no-go theorem for the mass-radius relation of localized and stable field configurations, known as solitons. Defining the mass-radius index by $Γ\equiv \frac{\rm{d}\ln M}{\rm{d}\ln R}$, for real scalar field theories in $d$ spatial dimensions, we show that typical non-topological, non-relativistic, and spherically symmetric solitons cannot have $Γ$ in the range $[0, d]$.
